events.evidence: The Israeli Defense Forces notifies the United Nations that the 1.1 million Palestinians living north of Wadi Gaza in the Gaza Strip have been ordered to relocate to Southern Gaza within 24 hours
Israeli troops conduct "localized raids" into Gaza in an attempt to locate Hamas-held hostages
A teacher is killed and another teacher and a security guard are seriously injured in a stabbing attack at a high school in Arras

label.note: Gaza evacuation order and localized raids mark major escalation; Arras stabbing adds Europe terror concern.
